theorems.name: Submission.regcomp_covector_field_near_maximizer
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (η : ℝ), 0 < η → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ β : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm β ≤ 1 ∧ ξ x β = 1) → ∃ g : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n, StronglyMeasurable g ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (g x) ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 1 - η ≤ ξ x (g x)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
